data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value: • Formatting Method: Converts raw numeric values into stylized text • Currency Format ("C" / "C2"): Formats numbers with currency symbols and two decimal places ($155.63) • Number Format ("N" / "N2"): Formats numbers with thousand separators and fixed decimals (1,250.50). • Integer Display ("N0"): Rounds values to whole numbers with comma groupings (1,000). • Percentage Format ("P" / "P1"): Multiplies raw decimals by 100 and appends the percent symbol (15.5%).

data.value: • 1. Block Scope:Active only within a specific conditional (If...Then) or loop block structure. • 2. Local Scope (Dim):Declared within a Sub or Function; purged from memory when End Sub executes. • 3. Module-Level (Private):Declared at the class header; shared across all procedures until the form closes. • 4. Namespace / Global (Public):Declared in a standard module; accessible across every form throughout execution.
